title: Animus behavior document
description: A JSON behavior under behaviors/<namespace>/<path>.json or packs/<pack>/behaviors/<namespace>/<path>.json. The plugin's compiler is authoritative.

revision.description: Raise this whenever the file changes. Changed bytes need a revision above the last accepted one.

server.description: true makes a server-wide behavior: it has no NPC, uses server events only, declares only execution, player and global variables, and runs only when listed in server-behaviors.json.

entry.description: The routine a run starts with unless a trigger names another.

identifier.description: 1-64 lowercase letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter or digit.

module-capability.description: A capability of a Java module. Its arguments are checked when that module is installed.

anyOf.description: Shows action bar text to the triggering player, or the player named by player.
Advances a quest stage, by one unless by says otherwise, without passing maximum.

Starts, pauses, resumes, cancels or undoes the NPC's build. A start names a schematic in the schematics folder, or uses the NPC's saved builder section; it builds at x, y, z or where the NPC stands. Protection still applies.
Presents clickable options to the triggering player and publishes the validated click.

Engages or disengages the NPC's combat, attacks or releases a target, or guards a participant (no target stops guarding; player is the triggering player). Needs enabled combat settings; protection still applies.
Runs a console or player command; {player} becomes the triggering player's UUID and {player_name} their name. Allowed only for behaviors on the TOML allow-list, and never in a preview.
Gives the triggering player, or the player named by player, a written book. Pages use the dialogue colour codes. Reports given.
Gives the triggering player, or the player named by player, amount of an item (1 by default), with an optional name and lore. Reports given.
Turns the NPC toward a position or the triggering player.

Sends formatted text without a speaker: to the triggering player (trigger, the default) or the player named by player, every online player (all), the players in the NPC's or triggering player's world (world), or the console. {player_name} becomes the player's name.
Starts a route to a position in the NPC's world, or follows a reusable route. Completes when requested, or on arrival with wait.
Opens a chest GUI (kind inventory, the default), holographic menu, shop or, with Gloss installed, a Gloss menu for the triggering player.
Opens a shop for the triggering player.
Plays an animation of the NPC's rig on a layer (0-3). Higher layers blend over lower ones. Fires animation_finished when a once or hold clip reaches its end.
Replaces the NPC's route with a recording it walks to and plays once, in a loop (the default) or back and forth. With wait, a once playback completes when it ends.
Plays a sound at the NPC, or with at: player at the player, for the triggering player or nearby players. Server behaviors play at the player.
Turns the NPC to one of the named poses in its definition's poses.
Restarts the route or recording the NPC's definition declares; a stopped recording continues where it stopped. Reports resumed or nothing-to-resume.
Sends dialogue text to the triggering player, the player named by player, or nearby players; {player_name} becomes that player's name.
Changes the NPC's displayed name or skin until the runtime restarts or its definition changes.
Shows an item in an equipment slot, or clears the slot when no item is given. Lasts until the runtime restarts or the definition changes.
Sets a flag to value (true by default: any JSON value), optionally for expireSeconds; clear: true unsets it.
Sets a quest stage to value, or to a random stage from zero to below random.
Shows a particle effect at the NPC, or with at: player at the player, to the triggering player or nearby players. Server behaviors show it at the player.
Stops one animation layer, or every played layer, and returns to the rig's idle animation.
Stops the NPC's current route and any route it is following.
Takes up to amount (1 by default) of an item from the triggering player, or the player named by player. Reports taken, never more than held.
Teleports the triggering player (target: player, the default), or the NPC (target: npc), to x, y, z with optional world, yaw and pitch, or to the NPC or the player.
Shows a title and subtitle to the triggering player, or the player named by player.
Compares a flag with value (true by default) by exact JSON equality. An unset or expired flag is false: it equals false and nothing else.
True when the triggering player holds a permission. False when there is no triggering player.
Compares the NPC's spawned state and current health.
True when the triggering player, or any player with anyPlayer, is within the radius.
Compares a quest stage. An unset quest is stage zero.

type.description: The value type. any accepts every value; expressions and templates are converted to the declared type when written.

initial.description: The value until something writes it, of the declared type: a JSON array for list, an object for map, any JSON but null for any.

scope.description: Who shares the value: one run (execution, the default), one NPC, one player, one NPC and player pair, or everyone.

lifetime.description: Required for every scope except execution: transient values last until the server stops, persistent values are stored.

bindings.description: Fills null placeholders in arguments from declared variables, keyed by JSON Pointer.

operand.description: A declared variable, an expression, or a template with {{ expression }} holes.

value.description: A literal JSON value, or an operand. An object whose only key is variable, expression or template is an operand.

node-action.description: Runs a capability and waits for its result.

arguments.description: The capability's arguments.

expressions.description: Fills null placeholders in arguments with expression results, keyed by JSON Pointer.

templates.description: Fills null placeholders in arguments with template text, keyed by JSON Pointer.

node-condition.description: Tests a capability or an expression, then runs then or else.

arguments.description: The capability's arguments.

expressions.description: Fills null placeholders in arguments with expression results, keyed by JSON Pointer.

templates.description: Fills null placeholders in arguments with template text, keyed by JSON Pointer.

expression.description: Tested instead of a capability; must be true or false.

then.description: Runs when the condition is true.

else.description: Runs when the condition is false.

value.description: Any JSON value: true, false, a number, text, a list or a map

arguments.description: Compares a flag with value (true by default) by exact JSON equality. An unset or expired flag is false: it equals false and nothing else.
True when the triggering player holds a permission. False when there is no triggering player.
Compares the NPC's spawned state and current health.
True when the triggering player, or any player with anyPlayer, is within the radius.
Compares a quest stage. An unset quest is stage zero.

node-wait.description: Waits a number of behavior ticks.

node-repeat.description: Runs its body a fixed or computed number of times.

count.description: How many times the body runs: 0 to 128, or an operand computed when the loop starts.

maximum.description: The most passes before the run fails; 128 by default.

index.description: An execution variable that receives the 0-based pass number.

node-foreach.description: Runs its body once for each item of a list or map.

list.description: An operand that evaluates to a list or map.

as.description: An execution variable that receives each item.

index.description: An execution variable that receives the 0-based pass number.

key.description: An execution variable that receives each map key.

maximum.description: The most passes before the run fails; 128 by default.

node-while.description: Runs its body while an expression is true.

expression.description: Checked before every pass; must be true or false.

maximum.description: The most passes before the run fails; 128 by default.

node-continue.description: Starts the next pass of the innermost loop.

node-parallel.description: Runs independent branches, then joins them.

node-call.description: Runs another routine of this document.

routine.description: A routine of this document.

arguments.description: Declared variables assigned before the routine runs, each from a literal or operand.

result.description: A declared variable that receives the routine's return value.

node-return.description: Ends the current routine, optionally with a value.

value.description: The value the routine returns to its call's result.
A literal of the variable's type, or an operand converted to it.

trigger.description: An automatic start for NPCs that list this behavior, or for a server behavior.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

trigger-interaction.description: A viewer's validated hit on the NPC. Runs read context.sneaking and context.hand (main_hand or off_hand).

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

action.description: Which hit fires it; interact by default.

consume.description: An expression checked when the click arrives, over flags, facts, context.sneaking and context.hand. When it holds, the click belongs to this behavior: shops, hiring, GUIs, riding and selection do not see it. Omit to leave the click to them.

trigger-proximity.description: A viewer crosses a radius around the NPC.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

trigger-spawn.description: The runtime first presents the NPC.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

trigger-waypoint.description: The NPC arrives at a route point.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

waypoint.description: A route point index; -1 is a manually requested destination. Omit for any arrival.

trigger-timer.description: An interval passes while the NPC is active, or while the server runs in a server behavior.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

intervalTicks.description: Ticks between firings while the NPC is active. Server behaviors use at least 20.

trigger-dialogue_choice.description: A viewer clicks an option of an animus:choices prompt from this NPC.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

dialogue.description: The id of an animus:choices prompt.

choice.description: An option id of that prompt. Omit for any option.

trigger-module.description: The owning module publishes a trigger.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

key.description: A trigger a module registered, namespace:name.

trigger-build_finished.description: A build this NPC works on places its last block.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

trigger-build_paused.description: A build this NPC works on is paused by command or starts waiting for terrain, materials or builders.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

trigger-animation_finished.description: An animation started by animus:play-animation reaches its end: a once clip stops, a hold clip starts holding.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

animation.description: An animation id under animations/. Omit for any played animation.

trigger-player_join.description: A player joins the server. first: true matches only first joins, false only returning players.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

first.description: true fires only on first joins, false only for returning players. Omit for every join.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

trigger-player_chat.description: A player sends a chat message, optionally matching a case-insensitive pattern with * wildcards.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

pattern.description: Case-insensitive match of the whole message; * matches any text. Omit for every message.

trigger-command.description: A player or the console runs the Animus-managed command this trigger registers.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

name.description: The command to register, without a slash.

aliases.description: Other names for the command, at most 8.

permission.description: A permission node the sender must hold. Omit to let everyone run it.

description.description: Shown in the server's command help.

usage.description: Usage text shown in the server's command help.

trigger-server_start.description: The server behavior is first enabled after the server starts.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

trigger-player_world_change.description: A player moves to another world, optionally only from or to named worlds.

routine.description: Starts this routine instead of entry.

cooldownTicks.description: Overrides the configured cooldown, per trigger on each NPC.

from.description: Fires only when leaving this world. Omit for any world.

to.description: Fires only when entering this world. Omit for any world.
